## History

Christine Stuart was a [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student who was frequently seen in the company of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Rumors of Gilbert's potential engagement to Christine caused [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) significant distress during their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). However, after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) recovered from typhoid fever, he and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clarified past misunderstandings regarding Christine and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), revealing that there was no romance between [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Christine.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002), [v3 ch.Christine P3](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0003), [v3 ch.Christine P5](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0005), [v3 ch.Christine P7](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0007), [v3 ch.Christine P8](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0008), [v3 ch.Christine P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009), +77 more_
